INSERT INTO collection_manual_memberships (
                    collection_id,
                    item_key,
                    media_type,
                    media_id,
                    title_snapshot,
                    subtitle_snapshot,
                    position_key,
                    availability_status,
                    availability_reason,
                    availability_checked_at,
                    added_by
                ) VALUES (
                    $1, $2, ($3::text)::media_type, $4, $5, $6,
                    ($7::text)::numeric, $8::varchar, $9, NOW(), $10
                )
